slides.title: Illustrative phased delivery links activities to acceptance evidence
slides.role: Explain the sequence and the evidence produced by each stage.
slides.takeaway: Each stage produces evidence for the next delivery decision.

steps.label: Frame the decision
steps.summary: Agree the business problem and the evidence needed to select a bounded pilot.
activities: Review user journeys and operating constraints.
Identify the decision owner and acceptance criteria.

steps.label: Assess the change
steps.summary: Establish the current technical baseline and expose delivery dependencies.
activities: Review representative code and data flows.

steps.label: Build a bounded pilot
steps.summary: Implement a thin capability slice with measurable acceptance evidence.
activities: Pair product intent with engineering tasks.
Demonstrate the slice against agreed checks.

steps.label: Validate the result
steps.summary: Compare observed behavior with the baseline and resolve material gaps.
activities: Record remaining risks and release conditions.

steps.label: Plan the next increment
steps.summary: Sequence expansion using the pilot findings and delivery capacity.
activities: Confirm owners, dependencies and review gates.

steps.label: Establish ownership
steps.summary: Transfer repeatable practices and operational accountability to named teams.
activities: Confirm how outcomes will be measured.
